QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Firepower Matters
QuestInfo.0: Is the Blue Dragon Cannon restored? Talk to #bEdea#k at the #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k and find out.
QuestInfo.1: The Blue Dragon Cannon was restored. All that remains is to fire it. #bOperation Enter Heliseum Downtown#k will start once the enemies are scattered by the cannon.
QuestInfo.2: The firing is complete. Enter Heliseum Downtown while the enemies are in chaos.
